description:
GPS Historical Data (page: gps.press/historical-data/): the catalog of yearly series on Georgia's
    prisons, 1925-present. Each series is ONE publisher's measure (GDC and Board of Corrections annual
    reports, the Bureau of Justice Statistics, the State Board of Pardons and Paroles, DOJ, the AJC, UCLA
    Law Behind Bars, the GPS mortality registry) with its definition, coverage and caveats. Topics:
    deaths, homicides, suicides, violence, use_of_force, weapons, parole, time_served, lifers, population,
    capacity, budget, escapes, staffing. Never splice two publishers' series into one trend.
name: list_historical_series
